meta.name: content-research-brief
meta.description: Research trending topics, collect source articles, and generate a structured research brief for content creation. Stop writing from thin air — write from real sources. Use this skill when the user wants to research a topic before writing, collect sources for an article, create a research-backed content brief, or says "research [topic] for me", "find sources about [keyword]", "content brief for [topic]", "what's the latest on [product]", "research before writing", "collect articles about [keyword]", "trending news about [topic]", "gather sources for my article", "brief me on [topic]", "what are people saying about [product]", "news roundup for [keyword]", "research brief", "source collection", "content research", "prep research for writing".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 研究热点话题，收集来源，生成结构化简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果写文章前需要做扎实的调研。
copy.tagline_en: Research trending topics, collect sources, and generate structured briefs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to research before writing content.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会先搜索并获取 5-10 篇真实来源文章，自动标注主题，提取关键数据，然后综合生成独特的内容角度，最终输出一份结构化研究简报。
howto.when: 当用户想写文章前研究话题、收集来源，或说出“research [topic] for me”“find sources about [keyword]”等关键词时触发。

say.text: research HeyGen for a LinkedIn post
say.note: 输出关于 HeyGen 的简报和角度建议。

say.text: brief me on email marketing trends
say.note: 收集 2024 年邮件营销趋势的简报。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will search for 5-10 real source articles, auto-tag them by theme, extract key data points, and synthesize unique content angles, then output a structured research brief.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to research before writing, collect sources, or says "research [topic] for me", "find sources about [keyword]", and similar phrases.

say_en.text: research HeyGen for a LinkedIn post
say_en.note: Produces a brief and angle suggestions about HeyGen.

say_en.text: brief me on email marketing trends
say_en.note: Gathers a brief on 2024 email marketing trends.

say_en.text: gather sources for my article about AI tools
say_en.note: Compiles a list of sources for AI tools article.
